string.name: steam_workspace_subtitle
string.value: Accounts, farming, inventory, and network status

string.name: steam_workspace_intro
string.value: ASF Workshop brings Steam sessions and ASF core capabilities into a native device workspace. This page shows only connected capabilities and never changes inventory automatically.

string.name: steam_workspace_safety_desc
string.value: Inventory writes, trades, redemptions, and automatic transfers are off by default; secrets never enter ordinary logs or exports.

string.name: steam_workspace_status_idle
string.value: Choose a workspace entry to see the current stage.

string.name: steam_workspace_status_account
string.value: Account import and authentication will open after the authentication UI is connected.

string.name: steam_workspace_status_farming
string.value: No account is connected, so the farming action remains disabled.

string.name: steam_workspace_status_inventory
string.value: No account is connected, so there is no inventory to sync yet.

string.name: steam_workspace_status_network
string.value: Network diagnostics are reserved; proxy behavior will be verified on an API26 device.

string.name: steam_accounts_intro
string.value: This stage establishes the account import entry. Files will be passed to the parser service later, and sensitive fields are never shown here.

string.name: steam_accounts_empty_desc
string.value: Account metadata and authentication status will appear here after an ASF JSON or maFile import.

string.name: steam_accounts_import_json_pending
string.value: An ASF JSON file was selected. Parsing and secure persistence will run after the authentication service is connected.

string.name: steam_accounts_import_mafile_pending
string.value: A maFile was selected. Sensitive fields will never be shown here or in ordinary logs.

string.name: steam_accounts_import_cancelled
string.value: No file was selected and nothing was written.

string.name: steam_accounts_import_failed
string.value: File selection did not complete and nothing was written.

string.name: steam_accounts_secure_desc
string.value: Passwords, tokens, shared secrets, and cookies stay out of RDB, ordinary JSON exports, and logs.

string.name: steam_accounts_status_idle
string.value: The account import entry is ready; authentication service integration is pending.

string.name: steam_inventory_intro
string.value: Sync and inspect inventory before any write operation. Inventory writes, trades, and redemptions are disabled at this stage.

string.name: steam_inventory_empty_desc
string.value: Inventory pagination, search, categories, and drop status will appear here after a Steam account is connected.

string.name: steam_inventory_status_idle
string.value: There is no account to sync; the sync button remains disabled.

string.name: steam_inventory_status_filters
string.value: Filters updated; inventory data integration is pending.

string.name: steam_network_intro
string.value: Configure networking per Steam account. HTTP and SOCKS5 target the request layer; WSS/CM combinations remain unclaimed until API26 device validation.

string.name: steam_network_socks5_warning
string.value: SOCKS5 proxies cannot currently reach Steam CM (WebSocket) connections: sign-in, farming, and other CM-dependent features will be unavailable. Web and store features keep working.

string.name: steam_network_wss_desc
string.value: Connection testing does not require an account; saving proxy settings does. SOCKS5 and WSS combinations are reported as unsupported.

string.name: steam_network_no_account
string.value: Connection testing does not require an account; connect one before saving proxy settings.

string.name: steam_network_status_idle
string.value: Network settings are ready; account session integration is pending.

string.name: steam_accounts_import_success
string.value: Account file imported; credentials are stored only in secure storage.

string.name: steam_accounts_import_report_unknown
string.value: Unknown fields found; the migration report was retained.

string.name: steam_accounts_import_parse_failed
string.value: Parsing or secure storage failed; the import was not completed.

string.name: steam_accounts_import_read_failed
string.value: Could not read the selected file. Make sure it is not damaged or in use, then try again.

string.name: steam_inventory_status_not_logged_on
string.value: The selected account is not logged on to Steam; inventory sync stays disabled.

string.name: steam_inventory_status_adapter_pending
string.value: A logged-on account can use read-only sync; the button opens after the inventory adapter is connected.

string.name: steam_network_status_loaded
string.value: Loaded the selected account local proxy configuration.

string.name: steam_network_status_validation_failed
string.value: Proxy host or port validation failed; configuration was not saved.

string.name: steam_network_status_no_account
string.value: Connect an account before testing or saving proxy settings.

string.name: steam_workspace_status_accounts_loaded

string.value: What is a maFile and how do I get one safely?

string.name: steam_accounts_mafile_origin_desc
string.value: A maFile is not a download offered in Steam account settings. Steam returns authenticator secrets only while enrolling a new mobile authenticator, and ASF or another compatible tool stores that enrollment data as a local maFile.

string.name: steam_accounts_mafile_existing_desc
string.value: Steam does not allow the current shared_secret or identity_secret to be queried or exported later, and ASF cannot recover them. QR or password sign-in creates a session but cannot create a maFile for the existing authenticator.

string.name: steam_accounts_mafile_create_title
string.value: When you can obtain a maFile

string.name: steam_accounts_mafile_create_desc
string.value: Import a backup previously saved by ASF, SDA, or another trusted tool. An account without a mobile authenticator can also enroll a new one with a trusted tool and save the resulting maFile. Do not use online conversion sites.

string.name: steam_accounts_mafile_merge_desc
string.value: The app identifies the same account by SteamID64 first, then by a case-insensitive login name. Importing its maFile adds authenticator secrets while preserving the current session, profile, and cache. A different Steam account remains separate.

string.name: steam_accounts_mafile_risk_desc
string.value: Removing, migrating, or re-enrolling an authenticator just to obtain a maFile may invalidate the existing Steam mobile authenticator and trigger trade, Market, or gifting protection periods. The app never does this silently after sign-in.

string.name: steam_accounts_mafile_security_title
string.value: Protect it like the authenticator itself

string.name: steam_accounts_mafile_security_desc
string.value: The shared and identity secrets in a maFile can generate codes and authorize mobile confirmations. Never send, screenshot, upload, or log it. Import only through the local file picker and keep an encrypted offline backup and revocation code.

string.name: steam_token_authenticator_existing_title
string.value: The authenticator exists only in Steam Mobile

string.name: steam_token_authenticator_existing_desc
string.value: Its existing secrets cannot be exported again by Steam or ASF. Keep using Steam Mobile, or migrate separately only after understanding the protection-period risks.

string.name: steam_token_authenticator_backup_title
string.value: You already have a maFile backup

string.name: steam_token_authenticator_backup_desc
string.value: Import the same account's maFile from Account Management. The app preserves the current session and securely merges authenticator capability.

string.name: steam_token_authenticator_new_desc
string.value: A trusted tool must complete a new Steam Guard mobile-authenticator enrollment before a maFile can exist. Signing in alone does not produce a shared secret.

string.name: steam_home_onboarding_subtitle
string.value: Check whether this device can reach Steam, then add your own account. Every step below maps to a real action available in the app.

string.name: steam_home_onboarding_network_desc
string.value: Using the system network configuration to check the Steam Store, Community, Web API, Support, Checkout, and CM chat channel. No account, cookie, access token, or sign-in data is sent.

string.name: steam_home_onboarding_network_failed_hint
string.value: If some or all targets are unavailable, switch networks, disable invalid proxies, or review the full error in Network Tools under Settings. Working web pages do not guarantee that the CM chat channel is available.

string.name: steam_home_onboarding_login_desc
string.value: Open the Accounts tab and choose QR code, account password, or file import. Add only Steam accounts that you own and are authorized to use.

string.name: steam_home_onboarding_qr_desc
string.value: Generate a QR code and scan it with the Steam mobile app. In Steam's approval flow, choose Steam Client, verify the actual access location, and select Other. After approval, keep this page open while the app saves the session and synchronizes the profile.

string.name: steam_home_onboarding_password_desc
string.value: Use this when QR scanning is unavailable. The app continues with any email code or Steam Guard code requested by Steam. After submitting verification, wait for the current flow to finish instead of creating the account again.

string.name: steam_home_onboarding_mafile_desc
string.value: A maFile is not a normal backup exported by the Steam mobile app. It usually comes from your own Steam authenticator tool or ASF and may contain sensitive keys such as shared_secret. Importing a file with the same SteamID as an existing signed-in account merges the data instead of creating a duplicate.

string.name: steam_home_onboarding_step_sync_desc
string.value: After sign-in, the app saves the session first, then loads the name, avatar, profile, inventory, cards, badges, friends, and messages by component. Sources finish at different times, so a short loading state or empty list does not mean the account signed out again.

string.name: steam_home_onboarding_step_inventory_desc
string.value: Inventory is grouped by Steam and game, with names, images, links, and market prices refreshed silently. Farming considers only owned games with remaining card drops greater than zero. Review the game and account before starting.

string.name: steam_home_onboarding_step_social_desc
string.value: Friends, chat, and messages depend on the saved Steam session and a live CM connection. Enable system notifications for message alerts. Network or system background limits may delay updates until the app is opened again.

string.name: steam_home_onboarding_step_token_desc
string.value: QR or password sign-in usually provides a login session but not the shared_secret required for five-character authenticator codes. To use codes, import a matching maFile that you control and store securely. The Tokens page explains when no shared key is available.

string.name: steam_home_onboarding_safety_desc
string.value: Do not import maFiles, ASF configurations, or proxy credentials from unknown sources. Never share QR codes, verification codes, shared_secret, access_token, or refresh_token. Removing an account clears its saved session and related in-app cache.
